result:
I implemented round 359 (C-R358-01). The ten tempo/grid/Snap/metronome settings now stay set when the Studio workspace remounts on a narrow resize, while the page stays open. There was no STOP. I ran no browser or PERF rows; those belong to C, and the full gate belongs to root.

**What changed:** exactly the 5 files the task allows. I applied B's sketch as written (its hashes match) and changed no design.
- `workspace-session-store.ts` (new): one small store that holds the ten settings.
- `ArrangementContext.tsx`: creates one store per provider and exposes it through a new hook.
- `StudioWorkspace.tsx`: reads the saved settings once at mount and saves them on unmount. The tempo-seed logic is unchanged, and there is no new status write.
- `workspace-session-remount-ui.test.tsx` (new): rows WS1–WS5.
- Doc 235, in Georgian, with the exact line 4 required and the 7 template headings.

**Checks I ran** (logs in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-359/`):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Claims before and after | Before: identical to B's planning output. After: K2 `f269022 5`, K22 `1 4 1`, K24 `5 2`, K6 11, K21 `11 10` |
| New tests, before the fix | WS1–WS4 fail, WS5 passes |
| New tests, after the fix | 5/5 pass |
| Typecheck | passes |
| Lint | passes, 205 warnings (gate 358 also had 205, so none are new) |
| Biome on the 4 code files | clean |
| Covering set | 79 files, 1452/1452 pass; no test above 50% of its timeout |
| Mutants M-S1–M-S5 | each fails exactly the rows B listed; RM1/RM2 pass under all five. Run on a scratch copy; `store/` untouched |

**Code review** (code-reviewer agent; report saved as `a-round-359/code-review.md`): no Critical or High findings.
- **Medium, test coverage.** I treated it as Low because the task's MUTANT row already classes this gap as Low and says not to add rows. I ran extra mutants to measure it:
  - Dropping Snap, grid density, the seconds division, or both hand-chosen flags (one combined mutant) still passes every test.
  - Dropping grid mode or the musical division makes WS4 fail.

  I added no test rows, because the task fixes the file at 5 rows (K24). The reviewer suggested three: WS6, WS7 and WS8. They are listed for B in the report, and doc 235's TODO now notes the gap.
- **Two Lows sent to B, not fixed:** the metronome ref is only written during render, and the store's state fields are not `readonly`.
- **Architecture note for B:** keep the code as it is for now; later, possibly move the tempo/grid group into its own hook (`useWorkspaceTempoGrid`).

**Left for C:** TEMPO-REMOUNT and SETTINGS-REMOUNT at both screen sizes, METRONOME-AUDIO, CLEARED, RELOAD, VIEW-STATE (record only), REMOUNT, FOLLOW, PERF and G359-AUTH. The full test suite, the build, `npm run verify` and the e2e smoke are root's gate rows.

The full report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-359.md`. Nothing was committed or pushed.
